eventDetail.scope: The International Conference on Biomedical Engineering (ICBME 2026) provides a multidisciplinary forum for researchers, clinicians, engineers, scientists, and industry professionals to present and discuss recent advances in biomedical engineering. The conference focuses on emerging technologies and innovative research in areas including artificial intelligence in medicine, digital health, medical imaging, biomedical signal processing, bioinformatics, biomechanics, biomaterials, medical devices, healthcare technologies, digital twins, rehabilitation engineering, and related fields. The conference aims to foster collaboration between academia, healthcare institutions, and industry, and to promote the translation of research outcomes into clinical and healthcare applications.
